data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything stays on this device. No account, no server.
data.persisted: Guaranteed: the browser will not delete Madar data on its own.
data.notPersisted: Not guaranteed: the browser may delete data when space runs low. Back up regularly.
data.unsupported: This browser does not guarantee persistent storage. Back up regularly.
data.usageUnknown: The browser does not report a storage size.
data.tight: Storage is running low. Delete old backups or export files.
data.installWhy: Safari can delete data in a browser tab after 7 days without use. As an app on the Home Screen it is kept.
data.install3: Tap "Add" and open Madar from there.
data.installSeparate: The installed app and the Safari tab have separate storage. To move: export in the tab, import in the app.
data.installAlt: Three steps: tap the Share icon, choose "Add to Home Screen", tap "Add".
data.installReminder: Until Madar is installed: please back up regularly.
data.exportBlocked: Export ready ({size}). This frame does not allow downloads; in the real app the file is saved.
data.importConfirmText: Your current data is saved as a backup first and then replaced by the contents of the file.
data.imported: Imported: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}, {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.
data.pruned: Old backups deleted. The newest is kept.
data.testText: Creates test data, exports it, imports it again and compares. Your real data is not touched.
data.testOk: All good: saving, exporting and restoring work ({size}, {ms} ms).
data.errorSTORAGE_FULL: Not enough space on the device. Delete old backups or export files and try again. Nothing was changed.
data.errorIMPORT_INVALID: This file is damaged or not a Madar export. Nothing was changed.
data.errorIMPORT_TOO_NEW: This file comes from a newer Madar version. Update the app. Nothing was changed.
data.errorDB_TOO_NEW: The stored data comes from a newer version. Please update the app.
data.errorUnknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intro: Claude works for you: Madar creates jobs, Claude (in chat, keyword "madar") does them, results come back. Madar checks everything and plans on its own. Claude never plans.
jobs.suggestNone: Nothing to request right now. Upload material or practice.

jobs.withReport: Provide learning report for evaluations (progress only)

reason.DUE_REVIEW: These cards are due today. Reviewing them now helps you remember them longer.
reason.EXAM_PRESSURE: An exam that covers this is coming up, so it comes earlier.
reason.PREREQ_GAP: A foundation is still missing for this. Madar practises that first.
reason.RECURRING_ERROR: The same mistake happened a few times lately. A short exercise helps.
reason.NEW_MATERIAL: This is new content from your material.
reason.INTERLEAVE_CONFUSABLE: These task types are easy to mix up. Mixed practice helps tell them apart.
reason.FATIGUE: Your answers are getting slower and less sure. A break helps more than carrying on.
reason.GOAL_REACHED: You reached today's goal. More isn't needed.
reason.USER_OVERRIDE: You chose this. Due reviews stay in briefly.
reason.RELEARN: Review before the exam, spaced out, so it lasts until exam day.
reason.LATE_HOUR: It's late. Nothing new today, only a short review. Sleep helps you remember.
reason.PRETEST: A short pre-test shows what you already know. Mistakes are fine and don't count.
reason.NO_AI_FALLBACK: There are no tasks for this skill yet. Read the material first; tasks come from “Jobs”.
reason.REVIEW_LOAD: Many reviews are due today. New content waits until there is room.
reason.EXAM_NEAR: The exam is close. Review and an easy practice exam count now, nothing new.
reason.DAILY_LIMIT: Enough new cards for today. More would mean too many reviews tomorrow.
reason.TIME_BUDGET: Nothing more fits into your set time today. The rest comes tomorrow.
reason.BLOCK_TIME: You've been studying for a while. A short break helps you remember.
reason.WRONG_IN_ROW: Several mistakes in a row on things you knew. That happens when you're tired.
reason.NOTHING_TO_DO: Nothing to plan right now. Add material or have jobs processed.
reason.WORKED_EXAMPLE: For new procedures you learn from a solved example first, then similar tasks.
reason.FADING_HELP: Each correct task gets a bit less help.
reason.RETRIEVAL: These are facts. They stick best when you recall them from memory.
reason.WHY_QUESTION: This is about understanding. A targeted why-question helps more than many tasks.
reason.TASKS_ONLY: You already do this well. Only tasks now, no solved examples.

examStatus.reachable: Everything is reachable before the exam.
examStatus.overload: There isn't time to cover everything safely. Madar prioritises.
